description: Several currencies (see main.zhang and 2024/01.zhang): each amount converted at its date, by the pair, its inverse or the cost currency, and the errors of the amounts no price converts, with their file and line.

requests.bql: SELECT date, narration, units(position) AS units, convert(position, 'CNY', date) AS in_cny, budgets FROM #postings WHERE account = 'Expenses:Travel' OR account = 'Expenses:Gifts'
